our_interpretation: The forecast concerns provider-imposed price increases coinciding with entry into a customer's product market.
The tentative account of Cursor supplies the analogy; it is not an explicit prerequisite for the forecast.
A qualifying increase requires higher charges for comparable access, including a mandatory migration or reduction in included service. An optional, more expensive model alone is insufficient.
For identifying candidate events, I interpret coincident as within 30 days. This interval was not specified by Zitron.
One affected product would establish an example, not the statement's scope of any product.
